title: Detailed Amount
description: A structure that represents a breakdown all of the different amounts that may appear on a single transaction.

gratuity_amount.title: Gratuity Amount
gratuity_amount.description: An optional additional amount representing the tip or gratuity associated with a payment. This should be included in the total 'amount' of the transaction.

cashback_amount.title: Cashback Amount
cashback_amount.description: An optional additional amount representing the cashback associated with a payment.

donation_amount.title: Donation Amount
donation_amount.description: An optional additional amount representing the donation associated with a payment. This should be included in the total 'amount' of the transaction.

tax_amount.title: Tax Amount
tax_amount.description: An optional additional amount representing the tax associated with a payment. This should be included in the total 'amount' of the transaction.

surcharge_amount.title: Surcharge Amount
surcharge_amount.description: An optional additional amount representing the surcharge associated with a payment. This should be included in the total 'amount' of the transaction.
